description: Set the merchant's business profile: legal name, address, tax registration, invoice prefix. Shown on checkouts and receipts ('Sold by X · GST 123'). Set collect_tax true to enable automatic tax at checkout — then activate Stripe Tax with activate_tax and declare registrations with add_tax_registration (no separate Stripe dashboard needed; gocushy merchants use Express accounts, which don't have one).

tax_country.description: ISO country of tax registration, e.g. NZ
